name: Round label disc that drifts toward the pointer
description: A 128px solid disc in the accent with a one- or two-word label centred at 16px in the dealt button weight, sentence case, on-accent ink (4.5:1). Hover: the disc scales to 1.06 (320ms ease-out); on pointer devices it may drift up to 12px toward the cursor with a 200ms lag and settle back on leave, the label drifting 4px less so the type seems to float on it. Place it where the hero blueprint puts its action, or centred under a short line as the lone action; it never covers the headline. Second action: the label alone in the ink, no disc. Phone: disc 104px, no drift.
signature: A round solid disc 128px across holding a one- or two-word label (a circle, not a pill or a rectangle) that grows slightly and drifts toward the pointer on hover.
phone: Disc 104px; no drift.
houseRuleCheck: One flat filled disc: no ring, no halo, no blur, no glow. Label in sentence case at 16px.

name: Disc row, siblings shrink
description: A row of three to five round controls on one baseline: each disc 48px across at 1440, 12px apart, filled with the surface tone and holding a centred 16px glyph in the ink (an arrow to the work, a link out, copy link, email), each one a real working control. Hovering one (150-300ms ease-out) fills it with the ink while its glyph turns to the ground colour and the other discs shrink to 0.9, so the hovered one reads as the lone large control. Use it for a small set of related actions at the foot of a card or a project; on a card in the surface tone the discs take the ground colour. It is an extra control beside the page's button, never its primary action. Colour roles: ground = page (or the card), surface tone = discs at rest, ink = hovered disc, accent unused. Phone: No hover: the row stays at 48px discs with 12px gaps, and a tap fills the pressed disc for 200ms without shrinking the others.
signature: A row of three to five 48px surface-tone discs 12px apart where the hovered disc fills with the ink and the others shrink to 0.9.
phone: No hover: the row stays at 48px discs with 12px gaps, and a tap fills the pressed disc for 200ms without shrinking the others.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Discs are filled with a tone, never ringed; glyphs are plain marks, not emoji.

name: Solid icon disc
description: A round, icon-only button: a solid disc 56px across at 1440 (48px on a phone, never under 44px so it can be tapped), filled with the ink, with one 20px glyph dead centre in the ground colour: an up-right arrow for "go", a plus for "open", two short bars for the navigation's menu button. No label; it carries an accessible name. Hover and focus swap the fill to the accent over 400ms ease-out while an arrow glyph turns 45 degrees (up-right becomes right); press scales to 0.94. On a calm page the hover may instead scale the disc to 1.1 over 150ms with no colour change (scale the disc, not the glyph). It is an extra control beside the page's button, never the page's primary action: it ends a card or a row of work (the arrow, 44px there, opaque) or is the menu button when the navigation has one. Where a card carries a picture, the 44px disc may sit 16px in from its lower-right corner. All discs on a page share one fill; the size follows the role (menu 56px, row arrow 44px). Colour roles: ground = the page, ink = the disc (the text colour, light on a dark page), glyph in the ground colour, accent = hover fill only. Phone: Stays a 48px disc with a 44px minimum tap area; a menu disc keeps 16px from the screen edges; hover becomes the press state (fill swap for 200ms).
signature: A 56px solid round disc holding one 20px arrow and no label; on hover the up-right arrow turns to point right while the disc fills with the accent.
phone: Stays a 48px disc with a 44px minimum tap area; a menu disc keeps 16px from the screen edges; hover becomes the press state (fill swap for 200ms).
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Glyphs are plain arrows, plus or bars, never an icon-topped card or a drawn illustration; a disc is a filled shape with no stroke and no shadow.

name: Quiet tonal icon disc
description: The secondary round control, built as a tonal disc: 56px across at 1440 (48px on a phone), filled with the surface tone and carrying one centred 18px glyph in the ink: an arrow or a chevron. At rest it sits calm beside a solid control, as the "back" arrow next to a solid "next" where the page steps through a set (the steps of a process, the plans, the rooms) and the arrows really step it. Hover and focus flood the whole disc with the ink over 300ms ease-in-out while the glyph turns to the ground colour and an arrow slides 4px along its direction; press scales to 0.95. It is an extra control, never the page's primary action. Use it on the ground or a flat colour field; over a photograph take the solid disc instead. Colour roles: ground = page, surface tone = disc, ink = glyph at rest and disc on hover, accent unused. Phone: Same 48px disc; hover becomes the press flood (200ms); a back and next pair sits 12px apart and both stay 48px.
signature: A 56px disc in the surface tone with one 18px arrow, set beside a solid disc as its quiet counterpart; on hover it floods with the ink while the glyph flips to the ground colour.
phone: Same 48px disc; hover becomes the press flood (200ms); a back and next pair sits 12px apart and both stay 48px.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern is a 1-2px ring with no fill; a ring is an outlined shape and a hairline stroke, so the ring is replaced by a surface-tone fill with no stroke. The flood-on-hover idea stays.

name: Bare two-bar menu glyph
description: A menu trigger that is only a glyph: two 2px bars 28px wide and 8px apart in ink on a 66px by 50px hit area, no box and no word, at the right of the navigation. It is dealt only where the ground behind it is controlled (a flat colour or a toned picture region that holds 4.5:1); over a busy photograph give it a solid disc instead. Hover: the shorter lower bar extends to full width (200ms). Open: the bars cross into an X. It is the menu control only: the first-screen action is a separate filled button in the accent, 48px tall, in the dealt corner. Phone: identical, 56px by 56px hit area, the only item beside the wordmark.
signature: A menu control with no box and no word: two 28px bars in the ink, the shorter lower bar growing to full width on hover.
phone: Identical, 56px by 56px hit area.
houseRuleCheck: A two-bar glyph is an icon, not a rule. It needs a controlled ground (4.5:1) or a solid disc under it; never bare over a busy picture.

name: Rounded square icon button
description: An icon-only button with soft corners: a 56px square at 1440 (48px on a phone), corners 12-16px (the card corner of the page, or half of it), filled with the ink; one centred 20px glyph in the ground colour (menu, arrow, external link). No label, no border; the name lives in an aria-label. Hover and focus fill it with the accent over 250ms and nudge an arrow 3px; press scales to 0.96. It is an extra control beside the page's button, never its primary action: the menu button when the navigation has one, or the open action in a card's top corner (44px there). Colour roles: ground = page, ink = block (the text colour), glyph = ground colour, accent = hover. Phone: Stays at 48px with a 44px minimum; the menu button keeps 16px from the screen edges; a card-corner button keeps 12px from the card's edges.
signature: A 56px square with 12-16px corners holding one 20px glyph and no label, filling with the accent on hover.
phone: Stays at 48px with a 44px minimum; the menu button keeps 16px from the screen edges; a card-corner button keeps 12px from the card's edges.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The optional 1-2px contrasting border of the pattern is dropped; filled shape, no stroke or shadow.

name: Sharp square icon button
description: An icon-only button with square corners: a 56px square at 1440 (48px on a phone), corners 0 to 2px, filled with the ink (or the accent when it is the page's one action). One 20px glyph sits centred in the ground colour (a menu mark, an arrow, a plus). No label, no border; the name lives in an aria-label. Hover and focus swap the fill to the accent (or to the ink if it began as the accent) over 200ms linear while an arrow nudges 3px along its direction; press mixes the fill 15% toward the ground. It belongs to a page where every edge is square and is an extra control beside the page's button, never its primary action: the menu button when the navigation has one, or the arrow that advances a row of work, flush at the row's right end. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = block (the text colour), glyph = ground colour, accent = hover. Phone: Stays square at 48px; the menu button keeps 16px from the screen edges.
signature: A 56px sharp-cornered square (0-2px) holding one 20px glyph and no label, whose arrow nudges 3px on hover while the fill turns accent.
phone: Stays square at 48px; the menu button keeps 16px from the screen edges.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The optional 1px light border of the pattern is dropped (no outline); glyphs are simple marks, not illustrations.

name: Pill email field with submit
description: The page's one sign-up field as a pill: 56px tall and 420px wide at 1440 (520px at the most), fully round, filled with the ink so it is the strongest surface in view, no border, 24px left padding, a 16px placeholder in the ground colour at 65% opacity and the typed text in the ground colour. The submit sits inside the right end, filled with the accent (arrow or word in the accent's ink): either a 44px round arrow button inset 6px, or a pill holding one word (120px wide, 4px inset). There is no hover; focus lights a 2px inner ring in the accent. One line at 16px, 16px under the field, says what happens next. Set it on the ground, 32px under a sentence. It is the page's one email form and is never repeated. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = field, accent = the submit. Phone: Field runs the column width at 56px tall, the submit stays inset in its end, the line below wraps.
signature: A 56px fully round email field, 420-520px wide, filled with the ink, with the submit inset 4-6px inside its right end as a round accent arrow button or a one-word accent pill.
phone: Field runs the column width at 56px tall, the submit stays inset in its end, the line below wraps.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No outline at rest (the ring appears on focus only); not placed over a photograph; the page keeps one email form.

name: Solid field with a separate action
description: A text field 52px tall and 380px wide with 6px corners, filled with the ink on a light page and with the surface tone on a dark page, no border. Placeholder 16px in the muted colour (4.5:1 on the field), 20px left padding; typed text 16px in the colour that reads on the field. The submit is the page's button: its own 52px accent block 8px to the right (140px wide, same corners, 16px label in the dealt button weight, on-accent ink), and every other button on the page takes this block. Focus: the field's fill lifts one tone step over 160ms and the caret turns the accent; no ring. Error: one sentence at 16px under the field. Used once, for a waitlist or newsletter, never repeated down the page. Phone: field and action stack, both full width and 52px tall, 8px apart.
signature: A solid field (the ink on a light page, the surface tone on a dark one) with no border and a separate accent block 8px to its right, not one bordered input with a button inside it.
phone: Field and action stack at full width, 52px tall, 8px gap.
houseRuleCheck: Dark filled field, no border, no inner box; every text 16px or more. It is the page's one email form.

name: Soft filled field with end icon
description: A single-line field with a soft end button: 8px radius, 56px tall and 420-560px wide at 1440, filled with the surface tone, no border, 16px text inset 20px, a muted placeholder, and at one end a 40px soft button (6px radius) in the accent holding a 20px send or search glyph in the accent's ink, inset 8px. Hover mixes the fill 8% toward the ink; focus lights a 2px inner ring in the accent over 150ms. Use it for the one field a page needs that does something real (an email sign-up, a question to the team, a filter of the page's real list), on the ground, 32px under a sentence. It is the page's one field. Colour roles: ground = page, surface tone = field, ink = text, accent = focus ring and the end button fill. Phone: Field runs the full column at 56px tall with 16px text (never smaller, so the phone does not zoom on focus); the end button stays 40px.
signature: A 56px field in the surface tone, 420-560px wide, with no border and a 40px accent send button inset 8px at its right end; focus lights a 2px accent ring.
phone: Field runs the full column at 56px tall with 16px text (never smaller, so the phone does not zoom on focus); the end button stays 40px.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's 1px grey border is an outlined box, so the field is a filled tone with no border at rest and a 2px accent ring on focus only.

name: Display-face pill, palette swap
description: A pill set in the display face: 56px tall at 1440, 36-40px side padding, the label in the dealt display face at the lead step in sentence case, one to three words, filled with the accent with the accent's ink as letters. Hover (250ms) swaps the whole button to a second pair: the fill goes to the ink and the letters to the ground colour; fill and letters are all that move, no growth, no roll. The two pairs come from the page's own palette, so the swap reads as a game of colours. Use it on a lively page where the type is the personality: the action is the one place the display face is repeated at button size. Colour roles: ground = page, pair A = accent fill with the accent's ink letters, pair B = ink fill with ground-coloured letters. Phone: Pill 52px tall, label at the lead step, 28px padding; hover becomes the pressed pair for 200ms.
signature: A 56px pill with a display-face label at the lead step that swaps its whole colour pair (accent fill to ink fill, letters following) on hover, with no growth or roll.
phone: Pill 52px tall, label at the lead step, 28px padding; hover becomes the pressed pair for 200ms.
houseRuleCheck: Sentence case at the lead step in the dealt display face (the pattern's capitals are not kept). The optional 1px ring of the pattern is dropped, so the swap is of fill and letters only; no gradient or shadow.

name: Pill that starts with a chip
description: A pill whose left end holds a chip: 56px tall at 1440, fully round, filled with the ink, with a round chip 44-48px across set 4px in from the left in the accent carrying a 20px arrow or plus in the accent's ink, then the label at 16px at the type system's button weight in sentence case in the ground colour, with 24px of extra padding at the right. Hover (300ms) turns the glyph 45 degrees and steps the pill's fill one tone (mixed 12% toward the ground). Use it for an action that opens one named thing: the chip is the coloured start of the button. Second action: a plain text link in the ink at the same size. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = pill, accent = chip. Phone: Pill 52px tall, chip 40px, label 16px; it grows to the column width when it closes a block; tap shows the press step.
signature: A 56px ink pill whose round 44-48px accent chip sits at its left end, inset 4px, with a 20px glyph that turns 45 degrees on hover.
phone: Pill 52px tall, chip 40px, label 16px; it grows to the column width when it closes a block; tap shows the press step.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The label is sentence case at 16px (the pattern allowed 12px capitals; that end is dropped); the chip holds a plain arrow or plus, never a thumbnail or a drawn icon.

name: Pill with leading play glyph
description: A pill 44px tall, filled with the ground colour and lettered in the ink, a 14px play glyph and then a 16px sentence-case label in the dealt button weight, 20px side padding, a 10px gap between glyph and label. It sits over the hero picture or the video poster (never over type), usually under the headline, labelled Watch the film or a similar two-word line. Hover: the fill steps to the surface tone over 160ms. Click opens the video in a full-screen layer. Dealt only where the page has a film. Second action: a plain text link in the ink at the same size. Phone: 48px tall, the same glyph and label, centred under the headline.
signature: A 44px pill with a play glyph before a two-word label, set under the headline over the film's poster, opening the film in a full-screen layer.
phone: 48px tall, centred under the headline.
houseRuleCheck: Filled pill with a glyph, sentence case at 16px. A control on the poster, never a box laid over type or a photograph's subject.

name: Solid menu pill
description: A pill 44px tall filled with the ink and lettered in the ground colour (where a section's ground is the ink, it takes the accent fill), a 16px sentence-case label in the dealt button weight and 14px later a 24px two-bar glyph at the right, 20px side padding. It sits in the upper right of the page margins and stays fixed while the navigation scrolls away. Hover: the fill and the letters swap (ink to ground, ground to ink) over 200ms. Open: the glyph crosses into an X, the label becomes Close. It is the menu control only: the page's action buttons take the same pill with the accent fill and the label alone, no glyph. Phone: identical, 44px with a 48px hit area; it is the only item beside the wordmark.
signature: A fixed solid pill in the upper right, reading Menu with a two-bar glyph, that outlives the navigation as the page scrolls.
phone: Identical pill, 48px hit area; the only item beside the wordmark.
houseRuleCheck: Filled pill, sentence case at 16px, a two-bar glyph as an icon. It stays opaque and keeps 3:1 against whatever it floats over.

name: Surface-tone menu pill, roll and grow
description: A pill 48px tall filled with the surface tone, no border, holding a 16px sentence-case label in the dealt button weight and, 12px to its right, an 18px two-bar glyph; 22px side padding. Hover: the fill goes to the ink and the letters to the ground colour, the label rolls up out of its mask and a second copy rolls in from below, and the whole pill grows 5% (400ms ease-out). Open: the glyph turns into an X and the label swaps to Close. It sits at the right of the navigation. It is the menu control only: the first-screen action is a separate filled button in the accent, in the dealt corner. Phone: 44px tall, same pill, the grow dropped.
signature: A surface-tone menu pill at the right end of the bar that grows 5% and rolls its label on hover, then turns its glyph into an X and the word into Close.
phone: 44px pill; no grow.
houseRuleCheck: Filled in the surface tone: no ring, no border, no shadow. Label 16px sentence case in the dealt face, no capitals.

name: Display-scale pill with arrow
description: A very wide solid pill, 70px tall and 576px wide at 1440 (the ink fill), holding a label of one to three words at the sub step in the display face, sentence case, at the left and a 28px arrow at the right end, 36px side padding. No ring or border. Hover: the fill moves to the accent and the letters to on-accent ink over 300ms and the arrow slides 8px right. It is the one closing action of a bold page and takes 160px of space above and below. Second action: the label alone at 16px in the ink with the arrow, no pill. Phone: the pill runs the margin width, 60px tall, label at the lead step, the arrow 20px.
signature: A pill 576px wide and 70px tall at 1440 with the label at the far left at the sub step and the arrow at the far right end, so the pill is much wider than its words.
phone: Margin-wide pill, 60px tall, label at the lead step.
houseRuleCheck: No ring or border: one flat fill. The label is sentence-case display type at the sub step, not a tiny label and not tracked capitals.

name: Pill with oversized label
description: A solid pill in the ink, 64px tall, carrying one to two words at the sub step in the display face, sentence case, so the type fills over half the pill's height; side padding only 25px, so the label nearly touches the curves. Hover: the fill moves to the accent and the ink to its on-accent pair over 200ms. It is a big, friendly pill for a closing or single-action moment, about 260-320px wide. Second action: the label alone at 16px in the ink, no pill. Phone: 56px tall, label at the lead step, 20px side padding, may span the margin width.
signature: A pill whose label is set so large (over half the pill's height) that the type nearly touches the rounded ends, with only 25px of side padding.
phone: 56px tall, label at the lead step; may span the margin width.
houseRuleCheck: Filled pill, sentence-case display type, no icon, no ring.

name: Poster-type pill
description: A poster pill: fully round, 72px tall at 1440, 32-40px side padding, the label in the dealt display face at the sub step (roughly 28-36px at 1440) in sentence case, one to three words, never small. The fill is the accent with the accent's ink as letters. Hover (300ms) rolls the label up (a copy rises from below, clipped by the pill), grows the pill 5% and turns the fill to the ink with the label in the ground colour. Reduced motion swaps the fill only. Use it as the loud action on a poster-like page, on the ground, alone or beside display type. Colour roles: ground = the page, accent = pill fill, ink = hover fill. Phone: Pill 60px tall with the label at the sub step, full column width when it closes the first screen; the roll stays on tap for 300ms, no growth.
signature: A 72px pill with a display-face label at the sub step (far above ordinary button text) that rolls up inside the pill on hover while the pill grows 5%.
phone: Pill 60px tall with the label at the sub step, full column width when it closes the first screen; the roll stays on tap for 300ms, no growth.
houseRuleCheck: Sentence case in the dealt display face at the sub step (the pattern's capitals are not kept: buttons are sentence case). No outline, gradient or shadow.

name: Solid pill that fades to a tint
description: A solid pill 44px tall in the ink, a 16px sentence-case label in the dealt button weight in ground-coloured letters, 24px side padding, and no border at all. Hover: the fill drains to the surface tone (150ms) while the letters switch to the ink, so the button looks emptied but never shows a ring. Press: the emptied state holds. Second action: the label alone in the ink, no box. Phone: 48px, the drain runs on press.
signature: A solid ink pill that empties to the surface tone on hover, with no border in any state.
phone: 48px; the drain runs on press.
houseRuleCheck: Ends in a flat surface-tone fill, never an outline or a ring; no border in any state.

name: Plain solid pill
description: The stock primary pill, used where the page's character comes from elsewhere: fully round (radius half the height), 52px tall at 1440, the label 16px at the type system's button weight in sentence case, 24-28px side padding, no icon. Fill is the ink or the accent with letters in the ground colour (the accent's ink on the accent). Hover steps the fill one tone (mixed 12% toward the ink, or toward the ground on an ink fill) over 250ms; press scales to 0.97. Place it 32px under the sentence it closes and keep it alone: the second action is a text link, never a second pill of the same fill. Colour roles: ground = page, accent or ink = fill, ground colour = letters. Phone: Full column width at 52px tall when it ends a stacked block, otherwise its natural width; hover becomes press.
signature: A fully round 52px pill in one flat fill with a sentence-case label and no icon (generic: nothing here tells it from a stock pill).
phone: Full column width at 52px tall when it ends a stacked block, otherwise its natural width; hover becomes press.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. This is one of the three stock shapes the review found on every page, so it is marked basic: the deal should prefer a distinct button and keep this as the fallback.

name: Compact pill that shrinks on touch
description: A compact pill 44px tall (hit area padded to 48px) in the accent, a 16px sentence-case label in the dealt button weight in on-accent ink, 22px side padding. Hover and press: the whole pill scales down to 0.95 over 500ms with an out-expo ease (a slow, soft settle), the colour unchanged. Used for in-card or in-row actions where a big button would shout. Second action: the label alone in the ink at 16px. Phone: the same size, the shrink runs on press only.
signature: A compact 44px accent pill that shrinks to 0.95 on a slow 500ms out-expo settle on hover and press, instead of growing or changing colour.
phone: Same 44px pill with a 48px hit area; shrink on press.
houseRuleCheck: Filled accent pill, 16px sentence case, no ring, no shadow. The shrink replaces any colour change.

name: Tonal pill that floods
description: A secondary pill that sits quietly beside the primary: fully round, 52px tall at 1440, the label 16px in sentence case at the type system's button weight, 24-28px side padding, an optional 18px glyph before the label. At rest it is filled with the surface tone with the ink for its letters and no stroke. Hover and focus flood the pill with the ink over 450ms ease-in-out while the letters and the glyph turn to the ground colour; press scales to 0.97. It appears as the second action next to a solid pill of the same height and corner, 12px apart, or alone on the ground. Dealt as the page's button design, the primary is the same pill filled with the ink (letters in the ground colour) and this tonal pill is the second action. Colour roles: ground = page, surface tone = pill, ink = letters and hover fill, accent unused. Phone: Both pills go full width of the column, stacked 12px apart (solid first), each 52px tall; hover becomes press.
signature: A fully round 52px pill in the surface tone with no stroke, beside a solid ink pill 12px apart, that floods to solid ink on hover over 450ms.
phone: Both pills go full width of the column, stacked 12px apart (solid first), each 52px tall; hover becomes press.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's 1-1.5px border would be an outline as the only shape, so the border is replaced by a surface-tone fill and the hover flood is kept; the label is sentence case, no tracked capitals.

name: Tonal pill with arrow chip
description: A secondary pill with an arrow chip at its end: 52px tall at 1440, fully round, filled with the surface tone, the label at 16px at the type system's button weight in sentence case in the ink with 24px left padding, and a filled arrow chip 32px across inset 10px from the right end (an ink disc with a ground-coloured 14px arrow). Hover (200ms) floods the pill with the ink while the chip inverts to a ground-coloured disc with an ink arrow. It goes beside a solid primary, or ends a list of rows as the "see all" action. Dealt as the page's button design, the primary is the same pill filled with the ink with its chip in the accent, and this tonal pill is the second action. Colour roles: ground = page, surface tone = pill, ink = chip and hover fill. Phone: Full column width at 52px tall with the chip kept inset; hover becomes press.
signature: A 52px pill in the surface tone with a 32px ink arrow disc inset 10px at its right end; on hover the pill floods ink while the disc turns to the ground colour.
phone: Full column width at 52px tall with the chip kept inset; hover becomes press.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's faint 1px ring is an outline as the only shape, so the body is a surface-tone fill with no stroke; the flood and invert on hover stay.

name: Solid pill with arrow nudge
description: A solid pill that ends on a bare arrow: 52px tall at 1440, fully round, the label 16px at the type system's button weight in sentence case, an 8px gap and a plain 14-16px arrow, 24-30px side padding. Fill is the ink with letters and arrow in the ground colour; the accent is not used. Hover (250ms) nudges the arrow 3px up and to the right, and the fill steps a tone (mixed 12% toward the ground). The restrained primary of a calm or luxury page. Second action: the label alone in the ink with the same arrow and nudge, without the pill. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = fill, ground colour = letters and arrow. Phone: Pill 48-52px tall at its natural width, full width at the end of a stacked block; the nudge runs on press.
signature: A fully round 52px ink pill with a sentence-case label and a bare 14-16px arrow that nudges 3px up and right on hover (generic: the stock pill).
phone: Pill 48-52px tall at its natural width, full width at the end of a stacked block; the nudge runs on press.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Arrow is a plain glyph; fill is a flat tone; sentence case.

name: Opaque pill with arrow chip
description: An ink pill with an arrow chip at its end: 48px tall at 1440, fully round, the label 16px at the type system's button weight in sentence case in the ground colour with 24px left padding, and a 32px round chip inset 8px from the right end holding a 14px arrow (the chip in the ground colour with an ink arrow). Hover (250ms) rolls the label (a copy rising from below) and turns the chip to the accent with the accent's ink arrow. Reduced motion swaps the chip colour only. Use it as the action that closes a statement; 32px of space under the sentence above. Second action: the label alone in the ink with the arrow, no pill. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = pill, ground colour = chip, accent = chip on hover. Phone: Pill 48px tall with the chip kept inset, full width in a stacked block; the roll runs once on tap.
signature: A 48px ink pill with a 32px round chip inset 8px at its right end; on hover the label rolls up and the chip turns the accent.
phone: Pill 48px tall with the chip kept inset, full width in a stacked block; the roll runs once on tap.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Opaque, filled, no stroke or shadow.

name: Pill with trailing dot, label roll
description: An ink pill with a small dot after the label: 56px tall at 1440, fully round, the label 16px at the type system's button weight in sentence case in the ground colour, 28px left padding, then a 6px dot in the accent 12px from the label and 24px from the right end. Hover (350ms) rolls the label vertically (a copy rises in from below inside a mask) and the dot grows to 8px. Reduced motion swaps the dot size only. It is the refined action of a luxury or studio page; keep it alone and 40px under its line. Second action: the label alone in the ink with the same roll, no pill and no dot. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = pill, ground colour = label, accent = dot. Phone: Pill 52px tall; the dot stays 6px; the roll runs once on tap.
signature: A 56px ink pill whose label is followed by a 6px accent dot that grows to 8px while the label rolls up on hover.
phone: Pill 52px tall; the dot stays 6px; the roll runs once on tap.

Fill is the ink or the accent with letters in the ground colour (the accent's ink on the accent). Hover mixes the fill 12% toward the ground over 400ms (or swaps the ink version to the accent in 200ms); press steps the fill one tone. Over a photograph it takes the ground colour with ink letters and a slow press instead (scale 0.98 over 400ms, the fill mixed 10% toward the ink). It fits a page of square pictures and square cards where one corner rule rules everything. Second action: the label alone in the ink, its underline fading in on hover. Colour roles: ground = page, ink or accent = fill, ground colour = letters. Phone: Natural width, full column width when it closes a stacked block, 52px tall; hover becomes press.
signature: A 56px square-cornered block in one flat fill with a sentence-case label and no icon (generic: the stock rectangle).
phone: Natural width, full column width when it closes a stacked block, 52px tall; hover becomes press.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. One of the three stock button shapes, so marked basic: the deal should prefer a distinct button.

name: Slim wide bar
description: A long, slim strip as the action: 520px wide by 44px tall at 1440 (about 12 to 1), 0px radius, filled with the ink or the surface tone, the label 16px at the type system's button weight in sentence case centred with no padding, no glyph (letters in the ground colour on the ink, in the ink on the surface tone). It reads as a slim strip of the page that happens to be pressable: set it under a form or a price on its own line with 24px above, centred or at the column's left edge. Hover (300ms) steps the fill one tone (mixed 12% toward the accent). Second action: the label alone in the ink, its underline fading in on hover. Colour roles: ground = page, ink or surface tone = bar. Phone: The bar runs the full column width at 48px tall; step on press.
signature: A 520px by 44px sharp strip (about 12 to 1) with a centred sentence-case label and no glyph, standing alone on its own line.
phone: The bar runs the full column width at 48px tall; step on press.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's 28px bar with 10px bold capitals is a tiny uppercase label and below the 44px tap size; it is raised to a 44px bar with a 16px sentence-case label. The long slim strip is the idea and stays, so it is no longer banned.

name: Wide bar with an end arrow
description: A wide bar with square corners, 56px tall and 380px wide at 1440, filled with the surface tone, a 16px sentence-case label in the dealt button weight at the left (24px padding) and an 18px arrow pinned at the right edge (24px in). Hover: the arrow travels 8px right and the fill goes to the accent with on-accent letters over 200ms. It reads as a destination row, one alone, set under a card or a short paragraph; stacked rows are a different pattern. Second action: the label alone in the ink with the arrow. Phone: margin width, 56px tall.
signature: A 380 by 56 square-cornered bar in the surface tone with the label at the far left and the arrow pinned at the far right, the arrow travelling 8px on hover.
phone: Margin width, 56px tall.
houseRuleCheck: Filled bar, sentence case at 16px, an arrow glyph; no border, no shadow.

name: Dark cut-corner tag, invert
description: An ink tag with two cut corners: 56px tall at 1440, 28px side padding, a 10px diagonal cut at the top-right and bottom-left corners (clip-path on a solid fill, no stroke), the label at 16px at the type system's button weight in sentence case in the ground colour, an optional 14px chevron at the right. Hover (300ms) inverts it: the fill goes to the accent and the label and chevron to the accent's ink. It gives a technical, hardware or game page an edge without any drawn decoration. Second action: the same cut tag in the surface tone with ink letters. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = tag, ground colour = letters, accent = hover fill. Phone: Tag 52px tall, full column width, the cut kept at 8px; the invert shows on press.
signature: A 56px ink tag whose top-right and bottom-left corners are cut 10px on the diagonal (clip-path, no stroke), turning accent on hover.
phone: Tag 52px tall, full column width, the cut kept at 8px; the invert shows on press.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's 11-14px wide-tracked capitals (tiny tracked label) become a sentence-case label at 16px and its optional 1px white border is dropped. The cut corners are the shape of the control itself, made with clip-path, not a drawn illustration. The cut-corner invert is the idea and stays, so it is no longer banned.

name: Skewed tag, label roll
description: A compact slanted tag: 44px tall and about 190px wide, the whole button skewed 12 degrees (transform: skewX(-12deg) on the button, the label and the arrow counter-skewed so the letters stand upright), square corners, so it reads as a parallelogram. Fill: the accent, with on-accent ink (4.5:1). Label 16px sentence case in the dealt button weight, 22px side padding, a 14px arrow glyph 10px after the label. Hover: the label rolls up out of a 20px mask while the same label rolls in from below, the arrow slides 4px right (240ms ease-out), and the fill steps to the ink with ground-coloured letters. Press: scale 0.97. Place it beside a short line of text or as the single action under a card title. Second action: the label alone with its arrow in the ink, the same roll on hover, no tag. Phone: the same 44px tag with a 48px hit area and the same slant; it goes full width only when it is the one action of its section.
signature: A parallelogram tag skewed 12 degrees with upright letters, not a rectangle or a pill, whose label rolls up through a 20px mask on hover.
phone: Same 44px slanted tag, 48px hit area; full width only when it is the section's one action.
houseRuleCheck: Label is 16px sentence case in the body face: no tracked capitals, no monospace. One flat fill (the accent) with on-accent ink: no tint, no second fill, no border, no shadow. The 12-degree slant and the roll are the idea; the tag is the button's own shape, not a drawn shape.

name: Big text with a leading arrow
description: An unboxed action in the display face at the head step, sentence case, one or two words, with a 14px arrow glyph 14px before it in the muted colour, the whole thing one line and a link with a 56px tall hit area. Hover: the arrow goes to the ink and the label slides 14px right (200ms ease-out), so the arrow seems to push the word on. It works like a headline that is also a button, used in a list of big destinations (separated by space alone) or as a section's closing line. As the page's button design it is also the first-screen action, in the accent ink. Phone: label at the sub step, the arrow 12px, hit area 48px.
signature: A link set at headline size with a small arrow before it: on hover the word slides 14px right as the arrow brightens.
phone: Label at the sub step, 12px arrow, 48px hit area.
houseRuleCheck: Sentence-case display type, no tracking, no rule or underline: a link set as large type, not a tiny label.

name: Big word under a picture cutout
description: An unboxed action 178px tall: a cutout about 104px high (a product render or studio cutout on a transparent ground, never an icon) above a word in the display face at the head step, sentence case, centred, 16px between, no box or fill under it. Hover: the cutout lifts 8px and tilts 4 degrees while the word's ink goes to the accent (240ms). It stands as a big action in a row of two or three such actions with 80px between. Phone: cutout 72px, word at the sub step, two across at 163px each. Needs a clean cutout for each, used nowhere else on the page; without them it is not dealt.
signature: A product cutout about 104px high standing above a head-step word with no box under either; on hover the cutout lifts 8px and tilts 4 degrees.
phone: Cutout 72px, word at the sub step, two across.
houseRuleCheck: A rendered or photographed cutout, not an icon, with no box or fill under it, so it is not an icon card. The word is sentence-case display type.

name: Large text link with arrow
description: An unboxed action set large: the label in the dealt display face at the lead step (roughly 19-24px) at the type system's button weight, in sentence case, one or two words, followed by an 8px gap and a 24px arrow glyph; ink on the ground, no fill, 8px padding for a 44px hit area. Hover (250ms) moves the arrow 6px right and turns label and arrow to the accent. Used as the closing link of a row of work or a list, right-aligned beside a section's heading, or stacked as two or three large links at the sub step, 24px apart. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = label and arrow, accent = hover. Phone: Same at the lead step, a stack at the sub step; arrow moves on press only; stacked links keep a 44px pitch minimum.
signature: A large unboxed link: a display-face label at the lead step with a 24px arrow 8px after it, which moves 6px right while both turn the accent on hover.
phone: Same at the lead step, a stack at the sub step; arrow moves on press only; stacked links keep a 44px pitch minimum.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's bold capitals are not kept (buttons are sentence case, and the type sits on the dealt steps); the label is sentence case in the dealt display face. No underline rule, no box.

name: Text with a sliding dot
description: An unboxed action in 16px sentence case in the dealt button weight, a 48px tall hit area, with 20px of room kept free at its right. At rest it reads as plain words flush with the column. Hover: an 8px solid dot in the accent appears at the place where the word began and the word slides 20px right (150ms ease-out), so the dot seems to hand the word along. As the first-screen action it rests in the hovered state: the dot in place, the word slid 20px and in the accent. In a quiet list, several stacked 8px apart, only the hover shows the dot. Phone: no hover; the dot shows by default beside the current item, hit area 48px.
signature: A word that hands itself 20px to the right as an 8px accent dot takes its place on hover.
phone: 48px hit area; the dot shows by default on the current item.
houseRuleCheck: Sentence case at 16px, one filled dot as a state mark, no rule.

name: Text that gains a block
description: An unboxed action in 16px sentence case (body face, the dealt button weight) with a small 14px arrow before it, 24px side padding in a 48px tall hit area, in the accent ink at rest. Hover: a block in the ink wipes in behind it from the left (240ms ease-out, sharp corners) and the letters and arrow turn the ground colour, so a line of text becomes a button. As the page's button design it is also the first-screen action. Suits a short list of destinations, 8px apart. Phone: 48px, the block fills on press.
signature: Plain words with an arrow that gain a solid ink block wiping in from the left on hover and flip to ground-coloured letters.
phone: 48px; the block fills on press.
houseRuleCheck: Body face at 16px, sentence case, no monospace; the hover block is the ink with ground-coloured letters, no second tone.

name: Text link with vertical roll
description: An unboxed text action in 16px sentence case in the dealt button weight in the body face, in the accent ink, a 48px hit area. Hover: the label rolls up out of a 20px mask while an identical copy rolls in from below (240ms ease-out), colour unchanged. As the page's button design it is also the first-screen action; it suits nav-like utilities and secondary actions where a colour change would be too plain. Phone: no hover; the roll plays once on press, 48px hit area.
signature: A text link whose label rolls up through a 20px mask and is replaced by an identical copy from below on hover.
phone: 48px hit area; the roll plays once on press.
houseRuleCheck: Body face at 16px, sentence case, no monospace, no capitals. The roll is the idea and stays.

name: Text link with leading play glyph
description: An unboxed action that opens the page's film, led by a glyph: a 14px play triangle, a 10px gap, then the label at 16-18px at the type system's button weight in sentence case ("Watch the film"), the ink on the ground, 10px vertical padding for a 44px hit area. It plays the film in a dialog or in place, so it is dealt only where the page has one. At rest it is static; hover and focus (200ms) turn the label and the glyph to the accent and fade in a 1.5px underline under the label (text-decoration-color; never drawn in from one side). Place it beside the primary button on a first screen or under a heading. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = label and glyph, accent = hover. Phone: Same size under the sentence, left-aligned; hover becomes the pressed colour.
signature: A text link led by a 14px play triangle that opens the page's film, the label and glyph turning accent with an underline fading in on hover.
phone: Same size under the sentence, left-aligned; hover becomes the pressed colour.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern's 12px tracked monospace capitals (house bans: tiny tracked labels, no monospace) are replaced by a sans sentence-case label at 16px. The play glyph is a plain icon, not a drawn shape, and the link is dealt only with a real film. The hover underline fades in rather than drawing in.

name: Plain word action
description: An unboxed text action of one to three words at 16px, sentence case, in the dealt button weight: no glyph, no underline, no box. It sits 12px under the sentence it belongs to, or beside another action of the page as its quiet partner (24px gap). The hit area is 48px tall by the text width plus 16px of invisible padding each side. Because nothing else marks it as clickable it takes the accent as its ink (4.5:1 on its ground). Hover: the ink moves from the accent to the page ink over 160ms. As the page's button design it is also the first-screen action: give it 24px of clear space and nothing competing beside it. Phone: the hit area stays 48px and it drops to its own line under the text it belongs to.
signature: No box, no rule and no glyph: one to three words in the accent ink that turn to the page ink on hover.
phone: 16px, 48px hit area; drops to its own line under the text it belongs to.
houseRuleCheck: Sentence case, no rule, no icon, no underline. The accent ink must pass 4.5:1 on its ground, or the ink stays the page ink and the colour shift moves to the hover.

name: Text with trailing arrow
description: An unboxed action: sentence-case text at 16-18px at the type system's button weight, the ink on the ground, then a 14px arrow 8px after it, no underline at rest, 8px vertical padding for a 44px hit area. Hover (300ms) moves the arrow 4px right and fades in a 1.5px underline under the label (text-decoration-color from transparent to the ink, offset 0.2em; it never draws in from one side). It is the second action beside a button, the "read more" at the foot of a card, or the link at the end of a section's sentence. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = label and arrow, accent only if the page has no other link colour. Phone: Same size, left-aligned under its sentence; hover becomes an underline on press.
signature: A sentence-case text link with a 14px arrow 8px after it that moves 4px while an underline fades in on hover (generic: the stock text link).
phone: Same size, left-aligned under its sentence; hover becomes an underline on press.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The underline is a text decoration that fades in on hover (it drew in from the left before, which is a drawn line); never a hairline rule. Sentence case, not caps.

name: Underlined sentence link
description: A link that stays underlined: sentence-case text at 16-18px in the body weight, the ink on the ground, underlined permanently with a text-decoration at 1.5px thickness and 5px offset in the same ink; no box, no fill, 8px vertical padding for a 44px hit area. Hover and focus (200ms) thicken the line to 2px and turn the label and the line to the accent. It is the quietest action: the second action next to a button, the link at the end of a paragraph, an email address set as the action. Colour roles: ground = page, ink = text and underline, accent = hover. Phone: Same type size; sits left-aligned under its sentence with 44px hit area; hover becomes the pressed colour.
signature: A sentence-case link that stays underlined (1.5px, 5px offset) and thickens to 2px in the accent on hover (generic: the stock text link).
phone: Same type size; sits left-aligned under its sentence with 44px hit area; hover becomes the pressed colour.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. An underline is a link's text decoration, not a hairline rule or divider; the tiny leading dot of the pattern is dropped, and the text is sentence case.

name: Menu word with two-bar glyph
description: A menu trigger with no box: the word Menu at 16px in the dealt button weight, sentence case, in the ink, then 12px to its right a two-bar glyph 22px wide (two 2px bars 8px apart, square ends), on a 48px tall hit area with 12px side padding, at the right end of the navigation. Hover: the bars close from 8px to 4px apart (180ms) while the word stays. Open: the bars cross into an X and the word swaps to Close with a 160ms crossfade. Over a picture the ink is chosen to read on that picture (4.5:1); if the picture cannot guarantee it, put a solid pill under the trigger instead. It is the menu control only: the first-screen action is a separate filled button in the accent, 48px tall, in the dealt corner. Phone: identical, and it is the only item beside the wordmark; hit area 48px.
signature: A bare Menu word with a two-bar glyph at the right end of the bar and no box: the bars close up on hover and the word swaps to Close when open.
phone: Identical: word and glyph at the right of the bar, 48px hit area; the only nav item beside the wordmark.
houseRuleCheck: Sentence-case word at 16px, a 2px two-bar glyph (an icon, not a rule or a drawn shape); no counter or number. Over a picture the ink must hold 4.5:1.

name: Action tile in a flat fill
description: A large flat tile that is itself the action, one or two to a row: each tile six columns wide (about 638px at 1440 with a 20px gap) and 360px tall, with the page's corner, filled with the ink (letters in the ground colour) for the first and the surface tone (ink letters) for a second, never a wall of colours. The label is the button's label (two or three words, never a headline) at the sub step in the dealt text face at the type system's button weight, in sentence case, top-left, 32px in from both edges; a 48px round arrow chip sits in the opposite corner, 24px from the edges, in the accent on the ink tile and in the ink on the surface tile. Hover (350ms) steps the fill one tone (mixed 10% toward the ground) and turns the arrow 45 degrees; the whole tile is the link. Use it to send a visitor to two destinations (shop, book, enquire) at a section's end. Where the page needs one action elsewhere (the first screen), the same design runs compact: 280px wide and 72px tall, the label at the left at 16px, the chip 48px at the right, 12px in. Colour roles: ground = page, ink and surface tone = the two tiles, accent = the arrow chip on the ink tile. Phone: Tiles stack full width at 220px tall with 12px between, label at the sub step, chip 44px; the compact form is full width at 64px tall; tap shows the stepped fill.
signature: A tile as big as a card (about 638px by 360px at 1440) that is one link, with a two or three word label at the sub step top-left and a 48px round arrow chip in the opposite corner turning 45 degrees on hover.
phone: Tiles stack full width at 220px tall with 12px between, label at the sub step, chip 44px; the compact form is full width at 64px tall; tap shows the stepped fill.
houseRuleCheck: The pattern showed rows of differently coloured tiles; that is colour sprawl and a wall of tiles, so at most two tiles, in the ink and the surface tone. The tile is not a card: it holds the label and the arrow chip only, no picture, no icon, no body text.

name: Display-type bar
description: One block, about 690px wide and 150px tall at 1440 (half the content width), filled with the ink (letters in the ground colour), in the dealt corner, holding a single label of one or two short words at the display step (display face, one line) with 48px side padding. The whole block is the link. Hover: the accent floods up from the bottom in 400ms and the label swaps ink to match, a short label nudging 8px right. It closes a section, so it needs 160px of space above and below, and at most one short sentence near it, at the lead step or smaller. Its everyday form, for the first screen, the navigation and the cards, is the same block at button size: 52px tall, as wide as its label plus 28px each side, the dealt corner, the ink fill, a 16px label in the dealt button weight, the same flood on hover; the full block is used once, to close a section. Phone: the block runs the margin width, 120px tall, the label drops to the head step and may wrap to two lines.
signature: One solid ink block half the content width (about 690 by 150 at 1440) whose whole face is a one-line label at display size, the accent flooding up on hover; everywhere else the same block runs at 52px.
phone: Margin-wide block 120px tall, label at the head step on one or two lines.
houseRuleCheck: One label in the display face at the display step: no tracked capitals, no outline or rule. A box on a flat ground, never on a photograph.

name: Play thumbnail, filled
description: A video thumbnail 240px by 135px at 1440 with 12px corners holding a still from the film, a filled 44px disc in the ground colour at its centre with a 16px play glyph in the ink, and a 16px sentence-case caption (the film title, one line) under it, 10px below. No border. Hover: the picture scales 1.06 inside its clip and the disc grows to 52px (240ms). Click opens the video in a layer. Place two or three in a row, 24px apart, as a short choice of films. Its everyday form, for every other action on the page, is a 52px button in the dealt corner, filled with the ink, a 16px label in the dealt button weight; the film thumbnails are used once, as the choice of films. Phone: Stacked at full margin width, 16px apart; no sideways-scrolling row.
signature: Two or three 240 by 135 film stills in a row, each with a filled play disc at its centre and a one-line title below, that zoom 1.06 on hover: a choice of films, not one play button.
phone: Stacked at full margin width, 16px apart; no sideways-scrolling row.
houseRuleCheck: No border: the play disc is filled and the caption is 16px sentence case. The stills must be art-directed or footage, never archive photographs. On a phone the thumbnails stack: no sideways-scrolling row.

name: Stacked row bars with chevron
description: A stack of three to five rows, each as wide as its column (up to 880px at 1440), 80px tall, in the dealt corner, filled with the surface tone (rows 8px apart, so the gap does the work a line would do), a 16px sentence-case label in the dealt button weight at the left (32px padding) and a 20px chevron at the right (32px in). Hover: the row's fill goes to the ink with ground-coloured letters over 300ms and the chevron moves 6px right. Used for a short list of destinations or ways in. Its everyday form, for the first screen, the navigation and the cards, is one such bar at button size: 52px tall, as wide as its label plus the chevron and 24px each side, filled with the ink (letters in the ground colour), the chevron moving 6px on hover; the stack of rows is used once, as the list of ways in. Phone: the same rows, 72px tall, full margin width.
signature: A stack of three to five filled rows 80px tall, 8px apart, each with its label at the left and a chevron at the right that moves 6px on hover, so the destinations read as one set.
phone: 72px rows, full margin width.
houseRuleCheck: Rows 8px apart: the gap does the work a line would do, no rules. Separate filled rows are cards in a list, never a box in a box; use it for one list only.

name: Square play tile
description: A square tile 602px by 602px at 1440 (about 42% of the width), filled with the ink (letters in the ground colour), in the dealt corner. At its lower left, 48px in from the edges, stand a 48px play glyph and, 24px after it on the same line, a one-word label (Watch, Play) at the display step in the display face; the upper part of the tile stays empty. The whole tile opens a video in a full-screen layer. Hover: the fill floods to the accent from the bottom in 400ms, the glyph scales 1.15 and the label's ink swaps to match. Place it beside a short heading and nothing else, with 160px of space around. Its everyday form, for the first screen, the navigation and the cards, is a 52px button in the dealt corner, the ink fill, a 16px play glyph before a 16px label only where the action opens the film, the same flood on hover; the full tile is used once, beside the heading of the film. Phone: a margin-wide square (358px at 390), label at the head step, glyph 40px.
signature: A 602px square ink tile (about 42% of the width) with a play glyph and a one-word label at display size at its lower left and the rest empty, the accent flooding it on hover; everywhere else the same design runs as a 52px button.
phone: Margin-wide square, label at the head step, glyph 40px.
houseRuleCheck: One filled tile with a glyph and one word, on a flat ground, never on a photograph; one box beside a heading, not a page of boxes. The play glyph sits on the label's line, so it is not an icon-topped card.

name: Platform download badge
description: A badge 48px tall and about 160px wide at 1440, using the platform's official badge artwork unmodified (the glyph at the left and the two-line label are part of that artwork, so it is placed as an image with its own corners). Two badges sit side by side, 12px apart, under a short line or beside a phone-screen picture. Hover: lift 2px over 160ms (a move only, no shadow). Only dealt for a product with a real app listing; use the platform's own clear-space rules. Phone: both badges 44px tall side by side at 150px each, or the one that matches the device.
signature: The two official store badges side by side, 48px tall and unmodified, 12px apart.
phone: Two badges at 150px by 44px side by side, or the one that matches the device.
houseRuleCheck: Official artwork as an image, no outline added by us. Only valid when a real listing exists; do not draw a lookalike.

name: Tall narrow side tab
description: A portrait tab 44px wide by 160px tall, square corners, filled with the ink, fixed at the right of the screen 10px in from the edge and centred vertically. Its label (one or two words, 16px in the dealt button weight, sentence case, turned a quarter turn to read bottom to top) fills the upper part and a 24px arrow sits at the foot. Hover: the tab grows 4px wider toward the content (200ms) and the fill goes to the accent. It keeps the page's one action in reach once the first screen has gone: it appears when the dealt navigation's own action has scrolled out of view and hides again whenever that action, or the closing action, is on screen, so one action never shows twice. The navigation keeps its action. Its everyday form, for the first screen and the cards, is a 52px block with square corners, the ink fill, a 16px label in the dealt button weight with the arrow at its right. From 1200px wide up the page margin holds the tab, so no text runs under it; below that it becomes the phone pill. Phone: a pill 48px tall pinned 16px above the bottom edge and the safe area, right-aligned, label horizontal, shown only while the navigation's action is out of view.
signature: A 44px by 160px ink tab fixed to the right of the screen, centred vertically, its label turned a quarter turn and an arrow at its foot, appearing only once the navigation's action has scrolled away.
phone: A pill 48px tall pinned 16px above the bottom edge and the safe area, right-aligned, label horizontal, shown only while the navigation's action is out of view.
houseRuleCheck: It sits 10px in from the edge in the page margin; a fixed tab is not a rail or a progress bar. No text runs under it. The navigation keeps its action; the tab shows only while that action is out of view, so one action never shows twice on a screen.

name: Wide tile with leading picture
description: A tile 320px by 128px in the dealt corner, filled with the surface tone, a picture 72px square at the left (inset 16px, 8px corners; a product shot or a styled still) and a 16px sentence-case label in the dealt button weight beside it, 16px gap, vertically centred. Hover: the fill goes to the accent with on-accent letters and the picture scales 1.08 inside its clip (240ms). Two or three such tiles in a row, 16px apart, all in the surface tone (the accent shows on hover only), serve as a choice of paths (for you, for your team). Its everyday form, for the first screen, the navigation and the cards, is a 52px button in the dealt corner, filled with the ink, a 16px label in the dealt button weight; the picture tiles are used once, as the choice of paths. Phone: stacked full margin width, 104px tall, the picture 64px.
signature: Two or three 320 by 128 tiles in the surface tone, each with a 72px picture inset at the left and a label beside it, as a choice of paths.
phone: Stacked, full margin width, 104px tall, picture 64px.
houseRuleCheck: 16px sentence case, no tracked capitals. The picture must be a real styled image, never an icon or an initial; a tile with a picture inside is one card, not a box in a box. All tiles share one fill; the accent shows on hover only.
